acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the .nit/skills/ directory, When listing skill directories, Then 7 core pipeline skills exist: clarify, phase-plan, create-tasks, design, implement, task-review, phase-summary.
Given any core pipeline skill, When reading its SKILL.md frontmatter, Then the name field uses the nit:* namespace and the hooks section references a per-skill validation script.
Given the nit:clarify skill, When invoked with a PRD path, Then it produces .nit/CLARIFICATIONS.md with clarifications, unknowns, risks, and assumptions sections.
Given the nit:review skill, When invoked on a task with all artifacts present, Then it produces REVIEW.md with a verdict of approved or rework-requested, and updates TASK.md status accordingly.
Given the nit:phase-summary skill, When invoked on a completed phase, Then it produces SUMMARY.md, creates a PLR in .nit/plr/, and updates PHASE.md status.
